claims: Vic Schaefer is the head coach of the University of Texas women's basketball team.
Vic Schaefer has held the position of head coach of the University of Texas women's basketball team since the 2020-21 season.
Vic Schaefer has led the Longhorns to multiple Elite Eight appearances.
Vic Schaefer has a contract extending through the 2029-30 season.
Vic Schaefer has achieved over 100 wins at Texas.
Vic Schaefer has taken the team to at least the Elite Eight in a majority of his seasons.
Vic Schaefer was formerly the head coach at Mississippi State from 2012 to 2020.
Vic Schaefer led Mississippi State to two NCAA Final Four appearances.
Vic Schaefer has earned national coach of the year honors during his career
